traceability.notes:
The story 003.0-DEV-FUNCTION-ANNOTATIONS is fully implemented and verified. Both core ESLint rules, require-story-annotation and require-req-annotation, are present, documented, and configured in the plugin presets. They share a common detection scope (FunctionDeclaration, FunctionExpression, MethodDefinition, TSDeclareFunction, TSMethodSignature) via a shared DEFAULT_SCOPE and shouldProcessNode helper, with arrow functions explicitly not part of the default scope and not configurable through the documented schema.
JSDoc and comment parsing for both @story and @req annotations use consistent, robust strategies built on ESLint’s SourceCode APIs plus additional heuristics (preceding lines, parent-chain comments, fallback text windows), with defensive error handling to avoid breaking lint runs on malformed AST or source information. Both rules support TypeScript constructs (TSDeclareFunction, TSMethodSignature, and TS function expressions), and expose matching configuration semantics for scope and exportPriority, with extensive RuleTester coverage that directly references this story and its REQ-* identifiers. User-facing error messages are clear, include function names, and provide actionable suggestions (including safe auto-fix behavior) while reporting errors at the function name or closest equivalent node, satisfying the user experience and error-location requirements. Comprehensive tests and rule documentation confirm that all acceptance criteria and listed technical requirements in the story are met.
